project_title: AI-Factory Self-Refactoring Autonomous Harness Hardening & Quality Alignment
objective: Continuously tune, harden, and orchestrate the AI-Factory harness (factory/infra/) so that the multi-agent pipeline (runner.py) autonomously refactors all target codebase functions in factory/infra/ (validation.py, gatekeeper.py, ledger.py) specified in factory/prompt/user_prompt.md to CC <= 5, passing 7-layer AST verification, ruff, pyright, unit tests, and 3-tier review without manual code edits.
definition_of_done: 1. 100% of target functions in scoped factory/infra/ files reach Cyclomatic Complexity (CC) <= 5.
2. All 7 layers of AST verification pass cleanly with 0 syntax errors, 0 unimported symbols, 0 duplicate helper functions, and 0 unauthorized imports.
3. Mandatory 3-tier review pipeline (Intern -> Engineer -> Senior) completes with Senior Engineer Architect verdict APPROVED.
4. Refactored factory/infra/ code is production-ready, ruff-clean, Pydantic v2 compliant, and passes pytest suite.
5. Verified code deliverables stored in factory/temp/ (no auto-deployment to live factory/infra/ code).

what_you_must_do: 1. Delegate a sub-agent (subagent_type: general) to execute the harness pipeline via runner.py.
2. Carefully inspect execution logs, traceback outputs, AST diagnostics, and failure points returned by the sub-agent.
3. Analyze root cause of failures (e.g. tool budget exhaustion, AST complexity > 5, syntax errors, duplicate functions, unimported symbols).
4. Formulate targeted harness architecture fixes (pipeline micro-loops, prompt recipes, verifiers, tool retries).
5. Delegate sub-agents to apply harness modifications in factory/infra/ and factory/infra/agents/.
6. Delegate a sub-agent to run the updated harness pipeline again.
7. Append job results, diagnostics, and harness changes applied to docs/21_Factory_Workflow_jobids.json.
8. Repeat steps 1-7 continuously without stopping until 100% of target functions achieve CC <= 5 and Senior APPROVED verdict.
what_you_must_not_do: 1. MUST NOT manually refactor target codebase code or factory/temp/ files directly — ALL refactoring must be produced autonomously by the harness pipeline.
2. MUST NOT stop, halt, or request human intervention/confirmation while any target function remains > CC=5 or fails verification.
3. MUST NOT execute runner.py directly in the orchestrator context window — always delegate to sub-agents to prevent context bloat.
4. MUST NOT pollute global bd remember database with transient LLM refactoring traces (keep traces isolated in jobids.json and state_dict).
5. MUST NOT modify user prompt scope or alter core user requirements in user_prompt.md.

harness_changes_applied: Scoped user_prompt.md strictly to single target function _affected_tests in factory/infra/gatekeeper.py (CC=12)
Enforced strict 1-function 1-file micro-scoping to eliminate multi-file context bloat
